seo.title: About EduHope | EduHope
seo.description: EduHope is an online English-learning platform that combines practical English education with opportunities for students to learn, share, earn eligible referral rewards, apply for tuition support, and participate in exchange programmes.

description.en: EduHope is an online English-learning platform that combines practical English education with opportunities for students to learn, share, earn eligible referral rewards, apply for tuition support, and participate in exchange programmes.

elements.name: text
elements.content: At EduHope, we believe that learning is not only about helping individual learners—it is also about creating opportunities for others to learn and succeed. We believe that education is a right for everyone, and every learner should have the opportunity to pursue their education regardless of their financial circumstances. Through EduHope, a portion of eligible course sales will be allocated to support students who are facing financial difficulties and need assistance with their university tuition fees. In this way, every learner who chooses to learn with EduHope can also help create an opportunity for another student.

content.en: At EduHope, we believe that learning is not only about helping individual learners—it is also about creating opportunities for others to learn and succeed. description.en: EduHope is an online English-learning platform that combines practical English education with opportunities for students to learn, share, earn eligible referral rewards, apply for tuition support, and participate in exchange programmes.
description.ar: EduHope منصّة إلكترونية لتعلّم اللغة الإنجليزية تجمع بين التعليم العملي للغة الإنجليزية وفرص تتيح للطلاب التعلّم والمشاركة وكسب مكافآت الإحالة المؤهلة والتقديم على دعم الرسوم الجامعية والمشاركة في برامج التبادل.

elements.name: text
elements.content: EduHope is an online English-learning platform that combines practical English education with referral opportunities, Tuition Support, and Exchange Programme opportunities.

content.en: EduHope is an online English-learning platform that combines practical English education with referral opportunities, Tuition Support, and Exchange Programme opportunities.
content.ar: EduHope منصّة إلكترونية لتعلّم اللغة الإنجليزية تجمع بين التعليم العملي للغة الإنجليزية وفرص الإحالة ودعم الرسوم الجامعية وفرص برنامج التبادل.

elements.name: heading
elements.content: How much does the English course cost?

content.en: How much does the English course cost?

elements.name: text
elements.content: The EduHope English Conversation Course costs $30 USD. The price can be changed by Admin.

content.en: The EduHope English Conversation Course costs $30 USD. The price can be changed by Admin.
content.ar: تبلغ تكلفة دورة EduHope للمحادثة باللغة الإنجليزية 30 دولاراً أمريكياً. ويمكن للإدارة تغيير السعر.

elements.name: heading
elements.content: How many levels are in the course?

content.en: How many levels are in the course?

elements.name: text
elements.content: The course focuses on practical English communication, speaking, listening, vocabulary, pronunciation, useful expressions, everyday English, academic English, and professional communication.

content.en: The course focuses on practical English communication, speaking, listening, vocabulary, pronunciation, useful expressions, everyday English, academic English, and professional communication.
content.ar: تركّز الدورة على التواصل العملي بالإنجليزية والتحدّث والاستماع والمفردات والنطق والعبارات المفيدة والإنجليزية اليومية والإنجليزية الأكاديمية والتواصل المهني.

elements.name: heading
elements.content: Do I receive a referral link when I register?

content.en: Do I receive a referral link when I register?
content.ar: هل أحصل على رابط إحالة عند التسجيل؟

elements.name: text
elements.content: No. A student receives a referral link after successfully purchasing the English course. A user who has not purchased the course can apply to become an Affiliate.

content.en: No. A student receives a referral link after successfully purchasing the English course. A user who has not purchased the course can apply to become an Affiliate.
content.ar: لا. يحصل الطالب على رابط إحالة بعد شراء دورة اللغة الإنجليزية بنجاح. ويمكن للمستخدم الذي لم يشترِ الدورة التقديم ليصبح مسوّقاً بالعمولة.

elements.name: heading
elements.content: How much is the referral reward?

content.en: How much is the referral reward?

elements.name: text
elements.content: The current reward is $10 for each eligible direct course sale. Rewards are subject to verification and the Referral Programme Terms & Conditions. Earnings are not guaranteed.

content.en: The current reward is $10 for each eligible direct course sale. Rewards are subject to verification and the Referral Programme Terms & Conditions. Earnings are not guaranteed.
content.ar: المكافأة الحالية 10 دولارات عن كل عملية بيع مباشرة مؤهلة للدورة. تخضع المكافآت للتحقّق ولشروط وأحكام برنامج الإحالة. الأرباح غير مضمونة.

elements.name: heading
elements.content: How can I become eligible for Tuition Support?

content.en: How can I become eligible for Tuition Support?
content.ar: كيف أصبح مؤهلاً لدعم الرسوم الجامعية؟

elements.name: text
elements.content: You must make 4 successful course sales through your EduHope referral link.

content.en: You must make 4 successful course sales through your EduHope referral link.
content.ar: يجب أن تحقّق 4 مبيعات ناجحة للدورة عبر رابط إحالتك في EduHope.

elements.name: heading
elements.content: Do I need to complete Level 4?

content.en: Do I need to complete Level 4?
content.ar: هل أحتاج إلى إكمال المستوى الرابع؟

elements.name: text
elements.content: No. Completing Level 4 is not a Tuition Support requirement. Tuition Support eligibility is based on making 4 successful course sales through your referral link.

content.en: No. Completing Level 4 is not a Tuition Support requirement. Tuition Support eligibility is based on making 4 successful course sales through your referral link.
content.ar: لا. إكمال المستوى الرابع ليس شرطاً لدعم الرسوم الجامعية. تعتمد الأهلية لدعم الرسوم الجامعية على تحقيق 4 مبيعات ناجحة للدورة عبر رابط إحالتك.

elements.name: heading
elements.content: Does reaching 4 sales guarantee Tuition Support?

content.en: Does reaching 4 sales guarantee Tuition Support?
content.ar: هل يضمن بلوغ 4 مبيعات الحصول على دعم الرسوم الجامعية؟

elements.name: text
elements.content: No. Reaching 4 successful sales makes you eligible to apply. The application is reviewed and financial assistance is not guaranteed.

content.en: No. Reaching 4 successful sales makes you eligible to apply. The application is reviewed and financial assistance is not guaranteed.
content.ar: لا. بلوغ 4 مبيعات ناجحة يجعلك مؤهلاً للتقديم. يخضع الطلب للمراجعة، والمساعدة المالية غير مضمونة.

elements.name: heading
elements.content: Can I apply for an Exchange Programme without making 4 sales?

content.en: Can I apply for an Exchange Programme without making 4 sales?
content.ar: هل يمكنني التقديم على برنامج تبادل دون تحقيق 4 مبيعات؟

elements.name: text
elements.content: Yes. Active EduHope learners can apply for available Exchange Programmes, subject to programme requirements.

content.en: Yes. Active EduHope learners can apply for available Exchange Programmes, subject to programme requirements.
content.ar: نعم. يمكن لمتعلّمي EduHope النشطين التقديم على برامج التبادل المتاحة، وفقاً لمتطلبات البرنامج.

elements.name: heading
elements.content: Can I become an Affiliate without purchasing the course?

content.en: Can I become an Affiliate without purchasing the course?
content.ar: هل يمكنني أن أصبح مسوّقاً بالعمولة دون شراء الدورة؟

elements.name: text
elements.content: Yes. You can apply through the Become an Affiliate page.

content.en: Yes. You can apply through the Become an Affiliate page.
content.ar: نعم. يمكنك التقديم عبر صفحة «كن مسوّقاً بالعمولة».

elements.name: text
elements.content: You can request a withdrawal when your available balance reaches the minimum withdrawal amount configured by EduHope. Pending rewards cannot be withdrawn.

content.en: You can request a withdrawal when your available balance reaches the minimum withdrawal amount configured by EduHope. Pending rewards cannot be withdrawn.
content.ar: يمكنك طلب السحب عندما يبلغ رصيدك المتاح الحد الأدنى للسحب الذي تحدّده EduHope. لا يمكن سحب المكافآت المعلّقة.

elements.name: text
elements.content: Use the Contact page to send a message to the EduHope team.

content.en: Use the Contact page to send a message to the EduHope team.
content.ar: استخدم صفحة «تواصل معنا» لإرسال رسالة إلى فريق EduHope.
